name: dread_presence_swamp_enters_2_damage_and_gain_2
notes: Printed: '... choose one - ...; This creature deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.' P0 plays a Swamp, picks the second mode and targets P1's 2/2: the 2/2 takes 2 from Dread Presence and dies, P0 goes to 22, nobody draws. A second Swamp the same turn is not playable (one land a turn), so the second land drop is checked in its own pack.
